scenes.purpose: A newly defined articulated animal prepares for a hop and lands without changing its identity.

narration.text: A small fox lowers its body before a short hop.
Its legs land first, then its head and tail settle.

scenes.purpose: A newly defined plant unfolds five independently hinged petals, retains the open pose, then makes a small reversible sway.

visual.title: An opening flower holds its new shape

narration.text: Each petal opens around its own hinge at the flower center.
The open flower keeps its shape as the leaves make a gentle sway.

scenes.purpose: A newly defined mechanical assembly closes two jaws around a sample, preserves the closed pose, and lifts the held assembly from its pedestal.

narration.text: The two jaws close around the sample while it rests on the pedestal.
The closed jaws and the sample rise together, keeping contact.
